summary: This directory provides foundational utility functions and shared schema definitions that support core application logic, including type safety helpers, JSON validation, and standardized API result structures.
responsibilities: Provide type-safe wrappers and assertions for control flow
Define standardized JSON and result schemas for API consistency
Expose utilities for stack trace analysis and debugging
Implement consistent error handling and result mapping for public APIs
relationships: Result schemas and error definitions provide a standardized structure for API responses.
JSON value schemas ensure type integrity for data interchange formats.
Exhaustive checks ensure that all possible result states are handled within application logic.
Public API execution helpers rely on result schemas to map internal errors into external-facing response formats.
designDecisions: Use of Effect Schema for runtime validation and type inference
Standardization of API success and failure responses via result schemas
Encapsulation of common logic to ensure architectural consistency across the project
Separation of public error formats from internal exception handling
